name: Audit Trail 1
definition: Describes information needed to identify a change for a static data, the time when it was performed and the user requesting the change and approving it.

FieldName.name: Field Name
FieldName.definition: Name of the field whose value has been changed.

OldFieldValue.name: Old Field Value
OldFieldValue.definition: Value of the field before the change.

NewFieldValue.name: New Field Value
NewFieldValue.definition: Value of the field after the change.

ApprovingUser.name: Approving User
ApprovingUser.definition: User who approved the change instructed by the instructing user.
